about: Follow-up questions an analyst might ask about the demo tickets. Every answer must have every quote found word for word in its source. 'expect' is set only where the right behaviour is objective: not_in_records (the data has no repair history, crash-event data or VIN), declines (not about the case), recheck (the analyst gives a new fact the decision depends on).
